Introduction

Bora is a South Korean singer-songwriter and actress under FNC Entertainment. She is a former member of the girl group Cherry Bullet.

She is also best known for participating in the reality survival shows V-1, Girls Planet 999, GIRL'S RE:VERSE and Queendom Puzzle.
